decisions.reason: Although it can reuse the firm's general recruiting capabilities, healthcare and hospitality recruitment sits far from its maritime knowledge base and current strategic focus, so management would likely reallocate resources to more related businesses.
Superyacht crew recruitment is a close adjacency to the firm's established crewing, training and compliance capabilities, giving it strong absorptive capacity to refine and scale the service.
The maritime education programme builds directly on the firm's training network and know-how, and the early expansion to six partner institutions shows strong learning and collaboration potential.

Emissions monitoring and compliance services fit tightly with the firm's maritime compliance expertise and digital direction, and the successful on-time submission of all required plans is strong evidence of commercial viability.
The emissions compliance dashboard is closely related to the firm's existing software and client workflows, and its integration into PAL suggests high internal capability to improve and embed it.

The emissions compliance cost simulation tool is an adjacent analytical extension of the firm's compliance and software strengths, so management is likely to keep developing it despite its early stage.
